avis.titre: Crazy Expensive For Amount, Same As Deconimo Brand Which Costs Less Than Half This Crazy Price
avis.texte: The Deconimo is the same product as the Eqqualberry, for less than half the price, while this costs a WHOPPING TWENTY-FIVE DOLLARS for a tiny bottle that's one-third empty on arrival. With Deconimo, what I got was slightly more concentrated, so it's a situation where you get more actives in the bottle than with Eqqualberry, which means that this Eqqualberry product will dispense easier but also require using more, while the Deconimo (as a result of being thicker due to less water content) requires tamping down the bottle to get the product to fill the dropper and then mixing a tiny amount of the product with a bit of your favorite toner or liquid-treatment in order to rub it on more easily. From what I can tell, having tested both, the Deconimo and Eqqalberry NAD+ Peptide Boosting Serums are identical, except for the Deconimo being thicker due to having less added glycols or water, where the glycols are both preservatives and filler-liquids (not particularly healthy ones) and where water is filler. I prefer aloe to both glycols and water, so the Deconimo is working better for me. Be advised that these two serums have a lot of niacinamide in them, which can burn your face, just like using a lot of a BHA or AHA will do to your face, so use this serum sparingly, no matter which brand you buy, but the Eqqualberry does have more water/glycol content to make it runnier, so you'll use slightly more here and run out faster than with the competing brand's product. I even noticed that,

avis.titre: My skin looks firmer, smoother, and has a healthy glow!
avis.texte: I’m 45 years old and have been very consistent with my skincare routine for years. I’m always looking for products with effective ingredients, so when I came across this serum with NAD+, peptides, and niacinamide, I decided to give it a try. The first thing I noticed was the texture. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave my skin feeling sticky, which is very important since I have combination to oily skin. I use it after cleansing and before my moisturizer on both my face and neck. After several weeks of consistent use, my skin feels much more hydrated, softer, and noticeably brighter. I’ve also noticed it looks firmer and more refreshed, especially in the mornings. It’s not an overnight miracle, but with regular use, the improvement is definitely noticeable. Another thing I appreciate is that it layers well with the rest of my skincare routine without causing irritation or breakouts. If you’re looking for a serum with advanced ingredients that helps improve hydration, firmness, and overall skin appearance, I definitely recommend giving this one a try. I’ll continue purchasing it.

avis.titre: Deep hydration, improves texture and leaves a healthy glow
avis.texte: This serum with NAD+ and 14 peptides has been an amazing addition to my skincare routine. Its texture is extremely pleasant; it glides very smoothly across the face and neck, completely absorbing itself without leaving any sticky or heavy traces. What stands out most is its ability to revitalize tired or dehydrated skin. From the first weeks of constant use, the face is visibly smoother, firmer and with a very natural and healthy luminosity. It also helps to smooth fine fine lines and improve the overall texture of the skin. It is a gentle formula that does not cause irritation and works wonders both in the morning and at night before the sealing cream. It is highly recommended for its excellent active ingredients.

avis.titre: Okay experience so far, but nothing impressive yet
avis.texte: I’ve tried this product a couple of times now, and my experience has been just okay, nothing great but not terrible either. After applying it, I didn’t really get that “wow” feeling. One thing I noticed right away was the added particles, which I personally didn’t love—they made the product feel a bit uncomfortable on my skin. It wasn’t painful or irritating, just not a texture I enjoyed. As far as results go, it’s still early, but I haven’t noticed any visible improvement yet. That said, I also didn’t have any negative reactions—no redness, itching, or breakouts—so at least it seems gentle enough for my skin. Pros: • No allergic reactions or irritation • Easy to apply Cons: • Texture isn’t very pleasant because of the particles • No noticeable results so far • Didn’t feel particularly good on the skin Overall, it’s a middle-of-the-road product for me. I may give it a bit more time to see if results improve, but based on my experience so far, it hasn’t stood out.

This is a very interesting serum, but it’s good! The white flecks feel firm, but disappear once you start moving it around the face. It’s really fun actually, to move it around and feel them disappear. I haven’t been using it long enough to notice any differences, but I have used it long enough to notice zero bad reactions! Which is always a huge plus for me. I don’t have super sensitive skin, but I’m always very careful when testing new skincare products. I didn’t notice any stickiness whilst applying. It’s also very hydrating! My skin felt really good after using this. All in all, I think this a decent serum. It’s also fragrance-free, which is great for people sensitive to fragrances. I personally don’t mind fragrances in skincare. I think this is a fun serum too, with the white flakes inside. I would recommend!

This serum has "ceramide cream flakes" - or in other words, a somewhat strange, chunky texture. It looks really interesting in the bottle, with the translucent pink serum and floating white bits- pretty but also slightly disconcerting. It feels pretty weird at first when applied, almost gritty, but the cream does melt and get absorbed after a few seconds. I love how it makes my skin soft, hydrated and glowing. I don't like how sticky it is, and I don't find it the most comfortable to wear, since the slightly tacky and heavy feeling persists even after it's otherwise fully absorbed. The serum doesn't have any scent to speak of, which I consider a good thing. This is overall a high quality and effective product, but the texture during application and somewhat sticky finish are definitely drawbacks for me. The bottle and dropper are high quality and give the impression of a luxurious product. This pack came with two bottles of serum, which is probably a 2-3 month supply as it goes a long way and I am only using it in the morning.

This two pack is a good value. The packaging on this product is really cute being all pink- would make a cute gift or stocking stuffer. As far as the product goes, it appears to be good. The product contains lots of anti-aging ingredients and provides hydration and a slight tightening effect on my akin. There is no discerning scent to the product and it does not go on sticky. The only thing I am not totally crazy about is the consistency of the product since it has little white flecks in it that I kind of need to rub into my face to get them to absorb. Once they are quickly absorbed though, the product is fine and help keeps my skin soft. I am not sure I love it as some of my higher end brands, but I think it is a great value and would be perfect for someone with less mature skin. I will probably use the second bottle as a stocking stuffer for my young adult daughter and she will love it!

The ingredients are very good too clean ingredients! I shared them below I would still follow up with a light moisturizer especially if you have dry skin like I do, but the ingredients here are sure to keep your skin moist as it draws in moisture, its a wonderful product, it's anti-aging and there is no retinol so you can use it day and night! I will be getting more once Its all done....Also, my skin is on the sensitive side and dry and it didn't cause any irritation at all.

Given the product brand name, “Eqqual Berry” and the color pink, I expected this serum to have a berry flavor smell, but it’s actually scentless. I prefer this so as to minimize potential irritation, but thought it was interesting! Those little white “cream flakes” are somewhat unappealing visually, but contain collagen to help with radiant looking skin, so I’m willing to look past that. It takes a little extra tapping to ensure those flakes are broken down and absorbed into your skin, and once done, it easily absorbs in. This serum actually leaves a bit of a matte finish along with an ever so sticky/tacky residue, so also helps with makeup priming. Excited to see if this will truly boost firming & radiance of my skin over time!

While the texture of this serum may LOOK somewhat unappealing with its "white flakes" appearance, it feels amazing! It doesn't leave any stickiness or film, rather absorbs well and leaves skin feeling clean and looking hydrated-glowy, not coated-glowy. It has no fragrance, which is wonderful for those of us who don't like to wear "face perfume" or have sensitivities to scents. It works equally well under SPF and makeup or under other skincare at night. I'd probably recommend this more to anyone newer to adding NAD+ and/or NAD+ boosters to their skincare routine, because I'm not convinced it is as powerful as other NAD+ skincare I use. That said, it has been giving an extra boost to my daytime routine (every other NAD+ product I have is part of my nighttime routine), so I'm still loving it. Full ingredients in photos.

Love love LOVE THIS! First of all, the packaging and the bottle couldn’t be cuter. I’ll admit I wanted to try this serum because I thought the bottle was irresistible. What a surprise to find the neverending number of amazing ingredients it has in it. Seriously, there’s no way I could list them all or even give shoutout the standouts. I use a popular skincare ingredients “decoder” to check all my skincare and this has a whopping 34 ingredients considered to be a “goodie” or a “superstar” ingredient and has nothing labeled problematic. That’s really impressive. And yes, it’s alcohol free, fragrance free and essential oil free. No dyes or anything weird. Just good clean Korean made skincare! I love that the product comes with a little insert with product information in a wide number of different languages. I didn’t count but maybe a dozen? The serum itself feels fantastic. And it’s pink!! But naturally colored so no worries. It contains these little white “flakes” that melt when you apply the serum and it gives the skin a beautiful, moisturized finish. You do have to gently work the serum to melt the flakes and absorb the serum if the skin or room is a bit colder I noticed but it’s no big deal. This is just a stellar product. And it’s so adorable looking. Try it.

avis.titre: All goodies without the ickies, anti-aging and rejuvenating!
avis.texte: Yes! Finally, a serum that has all it's star ingredients in the first half of the ingredient list and not at the end. On top of that, while the list is long, it's all a bunch of skin goodie ingredients and no ickies! Id list put some but honestly, I'd just be telling you the entire list (I've uploaded a pic instead!). What puts a cherry on top is that it's fragrance free, doesn't have any annoying and sensitizing essential oils like the very common linalool or limonene and no alcohol! The pink color is natural and comes from the ingredients. This really is a lovely serum that would be suited for any skin type as the ingredients together all focus on providing anti-aging, skin rejuvenating, barrier support, hydration and soothing benefits. To top it all off, for this many quality ingredients, the serum is very decently priced. It also comes in a cute and heavy glass bottle. It's so nice! If you don't have a NAD+ product (plus a ton of awesome peptides!) yet in your skincare arsenal, give this one a try!

I’m impressed by the EQQUALBERRY NAD+ Peptide Boosting Smoothie Serum. I’m 52 and have sensitive, rosacea-prone skin, so it can be difficult for me to find anti-aging products that don’t irritate my skin. This serum is a wonderful in that regard. It is fragrance free, which is surprisingly difficult to find in skin care. Its moisturizing properties offer my skin a good amount of hydration, and the ingredients are all proven anti-aging fighters. My skin is smooth and soft after using this serum, and it gives me a nice glow. The serum comes in a two pack, and a little bit of the serum goes a long way, so each bottle will last a long time. Therefore, even though this product does is expensive, I do believe it offers good value for the money for those reasons. I’m very happy with this order.

In just a few days I am already appreciating the benefits of this Eqqual NAD+Peptide serum. The bags under my eyes look better, my skin feels hydrated and healthy, and my forehead lines have filled in some. It doesn't take much per use and is easy to apply using the lid dropper. I appreciate that it is unscented and feels like a high quality and well made product. Considering this order came as a 2 pack, this will last me a long time but I will definitely purchase again. The value is definitely there and this would also make a great gift or stocking stuffer for anyone!

No fuss, no irritation, just a nice dose of moisture that makes my skin feel cared for. Knowing it’s packed with ceramides and vegan collagen makes me feel like I’m giving my skin the good stuff it’s been craving. What I enjoy most is that healthy glow it leaves behind. Instead of looking dull halfway through the day, my skin seems to hang onto that fresh, lively look. The blend of NAD+, peptides, and pomegranate feels like a morning cup of coffee for my skin, giving it the pep it needs to face the day. It’s turned into one of those little rituals I look forward to, and I can honestly say my skin feels happier and a touch more youthful since I started using it.

avis.titre: This Serum is Packed Full of Anti Aging Ingredients
avis.texte: I really like this serum because it combines ingredients like peptides which supports collagen production over time with ingredients that make my skin look great and glowy today! I have used other products from this Korean skincare brand and I have always found them to be super high quality. I am happy to see this serum which targets signs of aging. The EQQUALBERRY NAD+ Peptide Boosting Smoothie Serum – Anti-Aging Korean Skin Care with 5 Ceramides & Vegan Collagen, Hydrating Antioxidant Serum for Firmness, Wrinkles & Radiant Glow (1.01oz) comes in a practical dropper bottle. Since the product isn't too watery, it is easy to distribute. It still absorbs quickly though and my skin feels plump and hydrated afterwards. avis.texte: This serum feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. It makes my skin look smoother and more refreshed right after using it. This has to be one of the more unusual (and fun!) looking serums I've tried. It sort of resembles a pink snow globe with little white snow flecks floating inside. Once applied, however, it was all business. One dropper is all I needed to cover face, neck and even the backs of my hands. The color and flecks disappeared into my skin and the serum was quickly absorbed, leaving behind a smooth, glassy feel without any stickiness. I feel confident using it during the day under makeup and at night before going to bed. Because this is a K-beauty brand, I know I can trust the quality, and for the formulation to be gentle. I've read so much about NAD+ and have been a fan of peptides for quite sometime, so to discover a serum containing both means I don't have to use multiple products. It will be awhile before I know if the serum is effective in terms of anti-aging, but I love the immediate effects on my skin, hydrated and definitely more radiant. The serum is fragrance-free and vegan, but the packaging does not mention cruelty-free, so I can't speak to that. A pamphlet inside the boxes gives information in 18 different languages, so this is obviously a world-wide seller. The expiration date is clearly marked on box and bottle, and the serum is good for 12 months after opening. To get two bottles at this price is a ridiculously good value.
